ruleDefinitions.name: Process Execution From A Potentially Suspicious Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a potentially suspicious execution from an uncommon folder.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\All\\ Users\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Default\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\NetworkService\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\addins\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\debug\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Fonts\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Help\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\IME\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Media\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\repair\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\security\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\$Recycle\\\.bin.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\systemprofile\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Intel\\\\Logs\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\RSA\\\\MachineKeys\\\\.*")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\IBM\\\\ClientSolutions\\\\Start\\_Programs\\\\") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\config\\\\systemprofile\\\\Citrix\\\\UpdaterBinaries\\\\") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\CitrixReceiverUpdater\\\.exe$")))
